description: This file defines the PathPoint class used to represent points and movement instructions (move, line, curve) in an animation path. It includes constants for path operations, constructors for different point types, and static factory methods for creating line, curve, and move points.

classes.name: PathPoint
classes.description: Represents a point in a motion path including its position, control points for curves, and the operation type to reach it from the previous point.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint representing a straight line to the specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: curveTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint representing a curve with specified control points ending at (x, y).

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Creates a PathPoint representing a move operation to the specified (x, y) coordinates.

calls: new PathPoint(c0X, c0Y, c1X, c1Y, x, y)
